name: Costa Rica

flag.description: Five horizontal bands of blue, white, red, white and blue, with the red band twice as tall as the others; the state flag places the coat of arms in a white oval on the red band toward the hoist.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the sky and opportunity, white peace and wisdom, and red the warmth of the people and the blood shed for freedom.

hook: Costa Rica is Thailand inside out: a thick red middle band, white beside it, and blue on the outer edges.
trivia: The red band was added in 1848, inspired by the French tricolour; the design is credited to Pacífica Fernández, wife of President José María Castro Madriz.
Costa Rica abolished its army in 1948, a step written into its 1949 constitution.
